principle: Optional formal academic enrichment is persistent scheduled instruction distinct from core curriculum and extracurricular clubs. Registration, attendance, completion and final record credit are separate authoritative states.
rules: Offerings and their capacity exist independently of player observation.
Registration is anchored to population_slot_ref and may exist before full NPC materialization.
Existing valid registrations consume capacity before new allocations.
Conference, seminar and additional_course are separate offering types with authored completion policy.
Eligibility and prerequisites must be explicit authored rules; they are not invented for a desired participant.
A represented presenter/instructor must be available for all required sessions.
Required venue capabilities must actually exist.
Every required session must fit the cadet's real available timetable including travel.
Full offerings use waitlist state; no extra seat is invented for player or NPC.
NPC registration may use academic interests, branch interests and explicit enrichment preferences after eligibility/feasibility.
Species, gender, culture, player proximity and narrative convenience are not generic registration weights.
The player receives eligible options and is never automatically registered.
Attendance does not automatically prove completion when completion policy requires assessment or practical evidence.
Completion evidence may be produced by later actual attendance/evaluation events.
Step 8 does not write final transcript, qualification or Academy-record credit; Step 19 owns that integration.
Registration alone grants no competence, grade, reputation, relationship or wellbeing effect.
Cancellation, withdrawal, completion or waitlist promotion requires explicit state/event provenance and preserves history.
